interventions.name: Marsh regeneration scheme
interventions.note: Middlesbrough Council programme — £55,000, from 2027-02. Scored against flood outcomes alone.

interventions.name: Thorntree wetland restoration Q3
interventions.note: Community Ventures Ltd plan — £40,000, from 2027-01. Overlaps the council scheme; neither counts the volunteers.

interventions.name: Marsh reeds and planting days
interventions.note: The hub’s own call for volunteers — the same ground as both funded schemes, run on goodwill.

interventions.name: Thorntree Tool Library
interventions.note: Sarafu commitment (TTOOL, GBP-denominated, giftable) — 12 recorded transactions. A commons instrument, not a priced service.

interventions.name: Repair café — tools and a laptop runner
interventions.note: Two open needs on the hub: tools and equipment, and someone to run the laptop.

interventions.name: Van and driver for community moves
interventions.note: Offered at fuel costs only — mutual aid, not a market service.

sips.title: The repair café
sips.what_changes: The hub, the tool library and two open needs all point at one table. Staff it and three signals move at once.

sips.title: The marsh scheme meets the volunteers
sips.what_changes: The council’s £55,000 scheme and the hub’s planting days name the same ground. Join them and the money buys hands.
